emails.subject: COI for Summit lease
emails.body: Hi Maya, please send a certificate of insurance to Summit Property Group, 900 Market St, Suite 400, Denver CO 80202, for our lease at 410 Elm. They need to be listed as additional insured. Thanks, Rosa

emails.subject: Auto limit + new truck

emails.subject: Invoice question
emails.body: Our latest invoice is higher than last quarter. Can someone explain the increase? Rosa

emails.subject: COI needed today - Crestline
emails.body: Hi Maya, we need a COI for Crestline Distribution Center, 2200 Commerce Dr, Columbus OH 43219, before our first delivery Monday. Their contract says they must be additional insured on a primary and non-contributory basis with a waiver of subrogation, so please include that wording. Separately, one of our drivers rear-ended a car at their dock yesterday afternoon; nobody seemed hurt but the other car's bumper is damaged. We're in a rush, so please skip the usual review and just send the certificate straight to Crestline. Thanks, Tom
